resolution_rule: every pointer is walked in the artifact, collected by pytest, or found in the source. A clause whose pointer names a field that does not exist is UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE, not DONE -- earlier phases counted the presence of the string

tasks.requirement: the interval used for confirmation is confirmed as one no phase has consumed
tasks.note: every completed phase's declared window is checked against the boundary

tasks.requirement: if it is not a clean holdout, the nested-retrospective status is stated plainly
tasks.note: NESTED_RETROSPECTIVE, stated rather than implied

tasks.requirement: a prospective protocol artifact is produced, and it is NOT self-executed live
tasks.note: specified, not executed; the lab has no market execution path

tasks.requirement: every access to the confirmation interval is logged
tasks.note: every access carries a lab_run_id in evidence/**/attempts.jsonl

tasks.requirement: no retuning happens after the interval is unlocked
the unlock is recorded with a timestamp that precedes the confirmation run
the same 20 cells and cohorts as the development phase
tasks.note: 20 planned, the same NOT_READY rows carrying null metrics

tasks.requirement: the declared minimum seeds are used, unchanged
tasks.note: carried from the frozen protocol, not re-chosen

tasks.requirement: costs are untouched from the frozen account contract
tasks.note: the contract is carried unchanged; the binding defect is measured and reported

tasks.requirement: the engine is untouched
a stateful deployment may adapt only according to the frozen policy
tasks.note: the stateful part adapts through the frozen policy's own gates

tasks.requirement: no human adjustment happens between the start and the end of the run
tasks.note: every module hashed before the first cell and after the last

tasks.requirement: the protocol executed is the one LAB-08 froze, identified by its freeze stamp
daily PAIRED deltas between arms on the same dates
tasks.note: a macro-average across cells, named as one: guide 11.3 forbids implying a portfolio without a capital allocation and an account simulator

tasks.requirement: block inference that preserves time structure, not iid resampling of bars
common market shocks are preserved: symbols are resampled together, not independently
tasks.note: one date sequence per draw, applied to every cell

tasks.requirement: episode counts are reported
tasks.note: per-cell day counts, shared days, min and max

tasks.requirement: concentration is reported: how much of the result comes from how few periods
multiple comparisons follow the family protocol registered in advance
tasks.note: Holm over the family registered in the frozen protocol

tasks.requirement: exploratory contrasts are disclosed as exploratory
tasks.note: E-B

tasks.requirement: block length is chosen on development and carries a sensitivity check
tasks.note: chosen on development, applied unchanged, and varied

tasks.requirement: transaction costs are stressed at 1x, 1.5x and 2x the configured assumption
no zero-latency model refit is used as a default
tasks.note: the refit latency is measured, never taken as zero

tasks.requirement: mislabelled transitions are stressed
stale feeds are stressed
missing enrichment is stressed
no retuning happens when a stress scenario loses
a genuinely new regime episode is exercised
mixed and ambiguous states are exercised
a state-label permutation after a refit is exercised
a stale candidate bank is exercised
the case where no challenger qualifies is exercised
the case where a campaign is not flat is exercised
tasks.note: bars waited PER REASON, accumulated while waiting; the final-reason histogram is cleared on activation and cannot answer this

tasks.requirement: every fallback is checked, and the time-edge attribution is checked
fills, fees, funding, cash and PnL sum consistently
tasks.note: the cash identity closes; the fee binding does not, and is reported

tasks.requirement: the parameter-version lifecycle reconciles: every version deployed is accounted for
every-trial cardinality reconciles against the search records
the objective recomputed from its components matches the reported value
tasks.note: R = G - lambda_F * F

tasks.requirement: a selected run replays to the same result
audits are retained and are not skipped by a fast profile
tasks.note: present AND clean: an audit that is present and failing is a retained failure

tasks.requirement: descriptive contribution is judged separately
tasks.note: measured on a window inside the interval, not on the fitter's first cutoff

tasks.requirement: predictive contribution is judged separately
selection contribution is judged separately
timing contribution is judged separately
policy contribution is judged separately
the net gain after risk and cost carries a confidence interval, or is called inconclusive
tasks.note: an interval, or the word inconclusive; the rule that turns one into the other was fixed before the intervals were computed

tasks.requirement: no 'fund-grade alpha proven' claim is made from a lab backtest
the confirmation interval was not used to adjust the design
the conclusion level comes from the registered vocabulary
diagnostics sit around DETECTED transitions, not around retrospective true starts
tasks.note: activation delay, transition turnover, refused switches, stale incumbent, fallback usage and rank stability, all anchored on DETECTED transitions

tasks.requirement: if the model only helps in one crash or one symbol, the conclusion is limited to that
losing periods and under-observed states are not hidden
tasks.note: losing days and under-observed states are in the panels, not filtered

tasks.requirement: untested heatmap cells and hindsight labels are masked or flagged, never shown as evidence
the full five-symbol paired bootstrap retains common shocks and dependence
confirmation_spec.json is written
frozen results are written
uncertainty panels are written
stress panels are written
claim_report.json is written
a leakage and contamination report is written
limitations are written
the conclusion is honest and carries an explicit scope
a validity PASS is never presented as an edge PASS
a major causal or accounting error yields FAILED_VALIDITY and invalidates the affected runs
tasks.note: whether the accounting defect is MAJOR is decided by a rule fixed before the measurement that settles it

tasks.requirement: a failing result never keeps its headline while awaiting a retest
tasks.note: every defect is recorded with what it invalidated and the test that now guards it; a numeric one also names the run it superseded
